hook_lines: This KitKat is from Don Quijote Osaka
It actually tastes like real alcohol?!

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: 0.09% alcohol — below Japan's 1% legal alcohol threshold
White chocolate + nihonshu aroma, cherry-blossom cream wafer
Not an actual sake brewery collab — Nestlé's own flavor blend
Originally a spring release, now a year-round souvenir item

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 킷캣 사쿠라니혼슈맛을 먹는 리액션 영상. 한 입 베어물고 술 향에 놀라거나 음미하는 표정 위주 클로즈업, 10~15초 분량이면 충분. 화이트초콜릿을 베어무는 순간과 향을 맡는 표정이 있으면 더 좋음.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 日本 KitKat 樱花 日本酒味 试吃

quotes.japanese: 食べるとやはり日本酒の味がぶわっと広がる。結構日本酒の香りがすごい。
quotes.translation: Once you eat it, the sake flavor really spreads out. The sake aroma is pretty intense.

quotes.japanese: ヤバ。まじ日本酒を飲んだ時の風味です。
quotes.translation: Whoa. This genuinely tastes like drinking real sake.

quotes.japanese: これは辛口の日本酒と言うか、癖のある日本酒の香り、味。
quotes.translation: This is more like a dry sake — it's got that distinct, slightly rough sake aroma and taste.

quotes.japanese: 私は日本酒好きだけど、キットカットの日本酒はどうかとおもう。あまり好きじゃない。
quotes.translation: I like sake, but I'm not really sure about this KitKat version. Not a big fan.
